meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Republic of Colombia) - Unitary national jurisdiction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition with constitutional supremacy; commercial matters governed by the Código de Comercio and Ley 1258 de 2008 for Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Colombia-European Union Multilateral Trade Agreement (in force 2013)
Colombia-United Kingdom Reciprocal Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (APPRI, signed and in force 2014; continued post-Brexit)
Colombia-Spain Reciprocal Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (APPRI, in force 2011)
Colombia-South Korea Free Trade Agreement (in force 2016)
Colombia-Japan Agreement for the Liberalization, Promotion and Protection of Investment (in force 2011)
Pacific Alliance Trade Protocol between Colombia, Mexico, Peru and Chile (in force 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT amendments); Ley 1357 de 2009 (asset freezing and terrorism financing); Decreto 1674 de 2019 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, RBF, administered by the Superintendencia de Sociedades); Decreto 830 de 2021 (compiled AML/CFT 'SARLAFT' regime); Superintendencia de Sociedades regulatory instructions on the RBF; DIAN Formato 560 (annual final-beneficiary tax reporting); Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. incorporation regime). Note: the Colombian statutory UBO identification rule is a direct or indirect holding of more than 5% of capital or voting rights, or the exercise of control, under Decreto 1674 de 2019; the 25% threshold stated in this dossier is the standardized pipeline risk-ratification boundary and does not derogate from the 5% statutory test.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the passport (bio-page) of each foreign shareholder and final beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia acceded via Ley 319 de 1996); for non-Hague origin states, Colombian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Mandato Especial) for incorporation representation and signature of the constitutive document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation, or equivalent registry extract, of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, U.S. Secretary of State)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO declaration and source-of-funds affidavit (declaración de beneficiario final y origen de fondos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin, with Colombian consular/notarial chain where applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Security Council consolidated lists, OFAC-SDN and OFAC sectoral sanctions, EU consolidated sanctions list, UK OFSI list, and Colombian UIAF/national terrorism-financing lists, in accordance with Decreto 830 de 2021 (SARLAFT) and FATF Recommendations 12 and 22. PEPs are identified for holders of prominent public functions at domestic, sub-national or international-organization level, including directors, magistrates, high-ranking military officers and senior state-enterprise officials; any PEP or sanctions match triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior-management approval, and, where required, a suspicious-transaction report (ROS) to UIAF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) at https://www.rues.org.co; homonymy certificate issued by the Cámara de Comercio del domicilio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Código de Comercio Arts. 33, 34, 35 and 36: the corporate identifier must be expressed in Spanish and in Latin-script letters; foreign terms are transliterated into the Latin alphabet and may be used only with a descriptive Spanish element; the denomination must include the type indicator 'S.A.S.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any registered name ('homónimo'). All RUES filings and the constitutive document must be in Spanish; bilingual documents require certified Spanish translation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names containing 'Colombia', 'Nación', 'Estado', 'Ministerio', 'Presidencia', 'Gobernación', 'Alcaldía' (require prior authorization of the competent ministry)
Financial-sector terms: 'Banco', 'Financiera', 'Seguros', 'Bolsa', 'Valores', 'Fondo', 'Comisionista', 'Corredora' (require prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
'Cooperativa' (requires prior authorization of the Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria)
Health-care terms: 'Salud', 'EPS', 'IPS', 'Clínica', 'Hospital' (require prior authorization of the Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social)
Education terms: 'Universidad', 'Colegio', 'Institución Educativa' (require prior authorization of the Ministerio de Educación Nacional)
Protected official or international emblems: 'Policía', 'Fuerzas Militares', 'Armada', 'Cruz Roja', 'Defensa Civil' (generally prohibited for commercial names)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The homonymy certificate is valid for 30 calendar days and may be renewed by re-filing a fresh request. Upon rejection, the applicant may (i) submit a revised name for a new clearance, or (ii) file an administrative reconsideration (recurso de reposición) before the issuing Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, and, if denied, a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) under Ley 1437 de 2011 (CPACA). A final adverse SIC decision may be challenged through an annulment action (acción de nulidad y restablecimiento del derecho) before the Consejo de Estado.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A serviced/virtual office address is acceptable as the registered domicile for a purely digital virtual-concert ticketing S.A.S. provided the address is a real, verifiable geographic location within the municipal territory and the company maintains an operative physical anchor for management and regulatory notifications under Código de Comercio Art. 30 and Ley 1258 de 2008 Art. 17. DIAN and the Cámara de Comercio may request documentary or on-site proof of substance; fully virtual configurations lacking any physical presence are not registrable as a domicile.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: approximately 15% within the first 24 months for a low-risk, license-exempt ISIC 7110 digital ticketing vehicle; probability rises to 40% or higher if USDC/cryptocurrency payment volumes become material, cash or banking anomalies emerge, or UBO, PEP or sanctions flags arise.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed annually by the Cámara de Comercio board agreement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the private incorporation document (documento privado de constitución S.A.S.)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff issued by the Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry enrollment and RUES validation (inscripción en el registro mercantil)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff (0.7% of subscribed capital plus fixed inscription rights, capped per tariff resolution)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1, 3, 5, 9 and 22; Código de Comercio, Arts. 98-110; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 2, Part 2, Title 1.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office; integrated through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) registered in the Mercantile Registry; a public deed is required when the shareholders contribute real property or other assets transferable only by public instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a SAS. Subscribed capital, its value, and installment terms are freely determined by the shareholders in the bylaws; any unpaid subscribed portion must be paid within two years. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Colombian bank account opened in the company's name before registration; no separate escrow account is required under Ley 1258 de 2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the incorporation instrument and the bylaws of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada are approved, and the subscription of the authorized share capital by the founding shareholders is ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the registered office of the company is established at [service address], Colombia, and the legal representative is instructed to complete the Mercantile Registry registration with the competent Chamber of Commerce. RESOLVED FURTHER: that [Name] is appointed principal legal representative, [Name] substitute legal representative, and [Name] statutory auditor, if required by law, all with the powers conferred in the bylaws. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the principal legal representative is authorized to execute all documents, open bank accounts, obtain the RUT/NIT, and perform all formalities for the company's incorporation and governance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio online portal through RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Chamber of Commerce virtual window, select Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada as the legal form, submit up to three proposed corporate names, and receive the negative name certificate evidencing that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered. This step does not require notarization.
required_dossiers: Identification document of each founding shareholder
Draft SAS bylaws containing the virtual concert and digital ticketing business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is identical or confusingly similar, resubmit the next proposed name or file a reconsideration request under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo, Arts. 74-76.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of capital contribution bank account and deposit of paid-in capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial institution authorized by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a bank savings or current account in the name of the company in formation and deposit the cash portion of the subscribed capital. Obtain the bank certificate of deposit. If capital is contributed in kind, prepare a sworn inventory and independent valuation approved by the founding shareholders. For unpaid subscribed capital, record the payment schedule in the bylaws with a maximum term of two years.
required_dossiers: Identification of the legal representative and shareholders
Bank account application and anti-money-laundering forms
Sworn inventory and valuation in case of in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires a pending registration certificate, present the Chamber name clearance and prospective NIT application; if still denied, deposit the capital through a notarial deposit order or another bank authorized by the customer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and, if necessary, notarization of the incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public only when real property or registered assets are contributed; otherwise shareholders' direct execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders execute the private incorporation document containing the corporate name, domicile, term, purpose, subscribed and paid capital, representation rules, and governance provisions. If the contribution includes real property, the instrument must be granted by public deed before a Notary and the corresponding real-property transfer must be registered in the public deed registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or a shareholder identifies a missing clause, the incorporation instrument is corrected and re-executed; valuation deficiencies are cured by a sworn independent expert report.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile registration before the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument and complete RUES registration forms, pay the registration tariff, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. This certificate evidences the company's existence and legal representation before third parties and public authorities.
required_dossiers: Proof of capital deposit or payment
Proof of payment of registration tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar queries the submission, correct the deficiency and resubmit; if rejection is maintained, file a recurso de reposición before the Chamber and, secondarily, an appeal before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration before DIAN: NIT, RUT and electronic invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the Chamber-issued registration certificate to complete the Registro Único Tributario online, obtain the NIT, set the company's tax responsibilities, register economic activity code corresponding to ISIC 7110/NAICS 711310, obtain the electronic signature, and register the electronic invoicing system under DIAN Resolution 165 de 2023.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or returns the application, use the online correction channel to amend the form and resubmit; a definitive refusal may be appealed under Ley 1437 de 2011.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of statutory books, employer obligations and data protection filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio for book sealing; Administradora de Riesgos Laborales/EPS; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for data processing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register and seal the shareholders ledger and minutes book at the Chamber. If employees are hired, register the company as an employer and report salaries and contributions through the PILA system. Because virtual ticketing processes personal data, register the customer database in the Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos maintained by the SIC under Ley 1581 de 2012.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Privacy policy and data-processing authorization forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber objects to the books' form, correct the leading sheet and pay the re-sealing tariff; SIC registration deficiencies are cured by updating the privacy policy and resubmitting the database registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the virtual concert and digital ticketing activity does not operate a physical industrial, manufacturing, or venue establishment. General corporate oversight rests with the Superintendencia de Sociedades, and personal-data processing supervision with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license is required for virtual performance hosting and digital ticket tokenization in Colombia. If musical works are used, the company must obtain copyright authorization from SAYCO-ACINPRO and may register creative works at the Dirección Nacional de Derecho de Autor.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not applicable - no physical project requiring environmental licensing; if office or server infrastructure is physically established, jurisdiction becomes the Corporación Autónoma Regional for the territory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Exempt - no EIA, environmental license, or environmental registration is required for a digital platform without land disturbance, construction, or fixed industrial emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or combustion emissions are generated by the metaverse platform. The company remains subject to Ley 1672 de 2013 and Resolution 1512 de 2010 regarding ICT waste if electronic equipment is disposed of, and must use cloud or data-center providers that comply with applicable environmental management standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certification, structural load inspection, or physical venue clearance is required because the company operates without a public performance venue. If administrative offices are later leased, the company must obtain the fire department's Concepto Técnico de Seguridad Humana and the applicable electrical safety inspection under Ley 1523 de 2012, and comply with occupational safety obligations under Ley 1562 de 2012.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - official national tax and customs authority; taxpayer portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic tax services: 'Servicios Tributarios DIAN' (https://www.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign legal entities, including non-resident digital-service suppliers, must first appoint an attorney-in-fact or legal representative in Colombia with sufficient powers. The representative submits the duly legalized and apostilled constitutional documents (certificate of incorporation, bylaws, and board resolution appointing representative) to DIAN, either at a regional DIAN section or through the online RUT pre-registration system, using the form 'Registro Único Tributario (RUT)'. DIAN then assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). A foreign digital-service provider without a Colombian establishment may use DIAN's simplified electronic registration mechanism for non-residents and will be issued a provisional NIT/RUT; this registration does not in itself create a permanent establishment for income-tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope_Notes: The Colombian S.A.S. is a corporate income-tax resident because it is incorporated under Colombian law; it is taxable at entity level on worldwide income. For non-resident suppliers of digital services, only Colombian-source income is taxable, generally through withholding at source, and the non-resident is not a Colombian tax resident solely by reason of NIT/RUT registration. The entity is not a pass-through and no partner-level flow-through exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable: Colombia does not have a check-the-box or comparable entity-classification election; the S.A.S. is compulsorily taxed as a separate corporation under the Colombian Tax Code (Estatuto Tributario, ET). No hybrid mismatch fiscal-transparency election is available. Limited statutory choices exist for depreciation rates, inventory valuation, optional consolidated corporate income-tax filing under common control, and for small taxpayers the option to join the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (RST), but these do not alter the entity's default tax identity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto al Valor Agregado) - Colombian value added tax administered by DIAN under Articles 420 et seq. of the Estatuto Tributario.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A - There is no general monetary de minimis turnover threshold for IVA registration in Colombia. Any person habitually engaged in the sale of taxable goods or services in Colombian territory, and any non-resident supplier of digital services to Colombian final consumers not registered as an IVA responsible, must register for IVA through the RUT. Small taxpayers with gross income below statutory limits (currently up to 3,500 UVT per year) may elect the simplified 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (RST), but that regime is an alternative aggregation of certain taxes, not a threshold for VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory for all IVA-responsible parties. Invoices must be generated through DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free electronic invoicing application, and each sales transaction must be transmitted to DIAN in real time for validation as a 'factura electrónica de venta'. The electronic invoice must carry the unique electronic invoicing code 'CUFE' (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and a QR link to DIAN for verification. The issuer must transmit acceptance or rejection events from the purchaser, and all operations are subject to DIAN's API-based clearance and periodic event reporting; no physical tax-stamping is used.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% IVA rate applies to exports of tangible goods leaving Colombian customs territory, to services rendered to non-residents and used exclusively abroad where the benefit is realized offshore, and, with defined conditions, to digital services tied to foreign recipients. For virtual concert and metaverse ticket services, the taxpayer must prove the recipient is a non-resident, the service is effectively used outside Colombia, and the transaction lacks substantial local taxable use. Proof must be contemporaneous and documentary, including the applicable customs or service-export declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX/DUA) issued by DIAN's customs module
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / international transport document evidencing exit from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (Formulario de Declaración de Cambio) evidencing collection through an authorized local foreign-exchange intermediary
Export or service commercial invoice referencing the NIT, the zero-rated nature, and the foreign buyer/service recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to specialized DIAN audit under Articles 481 and 483 ET and the regulatory rules in Decreto 1625/2016. If conditions are not met or documentation is falsified, DIAN retroactively claws back the VAT not paid, adding daily interest and applying the 'sanción por inexactitud' for tax omission of between 100% and 200% of the greater amount of tax assessed if there are false, inaccurate or incomplete data (Article 648 ET). Persistent or intentional misrepresentation may also trigger criminal tax-fraud proceedings, suspension from the exporter registry, and seizure of goods or assets under the Colombian customs regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for authorization and prudential supervision, and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for foreign-exchange enforcement. The governing framework is the Political Constitution of 1991, the Organic Statute of the Financial System, Decreto 1068 de 2015 (Único Reglamentario del Sector Hacienda y Crédito Público), and Resolución Externa No. 8 de 2000 of the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a unified free-floating exchange-rate régime with daily publication of the Tasa Representativa del Mercado (TRM). The Colombian peso is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including cross-border ticket sales, royalties, service fees, and dividend remittances, without prior central-bank approval. Capital-account inflows, including foreign direct investment into a Colombian S.A.S., may enter freely but must be reported through an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary (Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario, IMC) and registered with Banco de la República; absence of registration prevents future profit remittance and capital repatriation. Profit distribution to non-resident shareholders is permissible after satisfaction of the 35% corporate income tax and the 10% statutory dividend withholding tax (subject to any applicable tax treaty relief), with certified financial statements and a valid foreign-investment registry record. There is no separate remittance tax. Virtual-concert revenues denominated in USD or USDC are not subject to exchange-control approval if received within Colombia's current-account framework and repatriated within the statutory timeline.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Ticketing and metaverse-service revenues qualify as servicio de exportación under Decreto 1068 de 2015. The Colombian exporter must transfer 100% of the gross foreign-currency proceeds into the national territory through the foreign-exchange market within six months following the fecha de exigibilidad (due date) of each invoice. The proceeds must be sold to an authorized IMC; no partial surrender ratio is available. Receipts settled in USDC must first be converted to fiat USD through a compliant crypto exchange or treasury counterparty and then channeled through the IMC within the same deadline. Failure to channel or late channeling triggers daily monetary fines and penalty scales of 10% to 200% of the unrepatriated amount under the régimen cambiario, plus potential SARLAFT regulatory scrutiny for the financial network.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational COP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Deposit Account
Operational COP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Deposit Account
Operational COP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Deposit Account
Operational COP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Deposit Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital electronic-money institutions (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, CurrencyCloud) possess neither IMC status nor SEDPE authorization in Colombia; their use as the principal treasury aggregation layer is rated Low–Medium. They may act only as non-bank payment facilitators for ticketing flows (Stripe Connect-style payout aggregation), with final settlement routed to a Colombian IMC account. Colombian SEDPEs (sociedades especializadas en depósitos y pagos electrónicos) may hold local COP float but cannot perform the foreign-exchange channeling declaration; a commercial-bank IMC is therefore mandatory for all USD-to-COP conversion and FX reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian AML regulations (Circular Básica Jurídica, Part I, Title IV) require identification of the legal representative. Physical presence at the branch is the default for a 100% foreign-owned S.A.S.; however, the SFC digital-onboarding framework permits remote KYC with biometric verification and notarized or electronically signed powers of attorney. In practice, Bancolombia, Banco de Bogotá, and Davivienda expect at least one in-person appearance by the legal representative or by a duly appointed Colombian attorney-in-fact holding a special and sufficient power with apostilled corporate records. Remote opening for non-resident directors is accepted only on a case-by-case risk basis after enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cryptocurrency (USDC) acceptance flagged under SARLAFT as high-risk virtual-asset exposure with potentially unidentified wallet counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Token-issuance policy and audited smart-contract repository; exclusive acceptance of regulated issuer USDC; whitelist of conversion exchanges holding local licensing or recognized international licensing; registered wallet-ownership ledger; policy requiring next-day conversion to fiat through the IMC; prohibition or strict cap on unhosted-wallet inflows for B2C ticket sales; FATF Travel Rule compliance records; AML/CTF manual containing crypto-specific red flags.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Metaverse virtual concert characterized as high-velocity low-value ticket flow with geographically dispersed purchasers and pre-event transaction bursts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-monitoring model with per-device, per-IP, per-card limits; 3-D Secure authentication and address-verification checks; defined refund and chargeback policy executed through the same ticket token; event schedule, maximum ticket volume, and platform contractual caps; audited agreement with the payment aggregator; segregation of ticket funds in a dedicated operational account; periodic SARLAFT reporting to the bank compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident ownership with minimal local physical footprint raising shell-company concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Cámara de Comercio; Colombian NIT; executed lease agreement for operational premises; payroll records for Colombian staff; evidence of substantive activity performed in Colombia for event production, licensing, customer support, and technical operations; sworn corporate income-tax return; shareholder tax-residency certificates and source-of-wealth statements; Registry of Final Beneficial Owners (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value single SWIFT capital contribution triggering source-of-funds verification and PEP screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution approving the capital injection; six months of contributing-shareholder bank statements; audited financial statements of the parent entity; published beneficial-ownership register; draft exchange declaration for foreign direct investment; legal opinion confirming compliance with capital-inflow routing and foreign-investment registration obligations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder must transfer funds in USD or EUR through a correspondent bank to the Colombian S.A.S.'s designated COP operational current account at the chosen IMC. The SWIFT MT103 must clearly identify the beneficiary account, the IMC bank BIC, and include the reference 'APORTE DE CAPITAL / INVERSION DIRECTA / CO_SAS' matching the shareholder resolution. The IMC converts the hard currency into COP at the TRM and simultaneously files the corresponding exchange declaration (Form No. 4, Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional y Financiación Externa); the investment must then be registered with Banco de la República within the statutory window (not later than six months from the transaction date) to protect future dividend remittance and capital-disinvestment rights. Verification package: incorporation documents of the investor, board resolution, proof of source of funds, OFAC and FIU screening, and the final-beneficiary certificate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for foreign artists' profit participation, metaverse-platform licensing, cloud hosting, and engineering vendors must be executed by SWIFT MT103 through the same IMC, accompanied by the Form No. 3 Declaración de Cambio por Servicios, Transferencias y Otros Conceptos. The MT103 instruction must specify the underlying contract reference, invoice number, and Colombian tax-withholding classification (15% or 20% withholding for foreign service providers as applicable). For cross-border procurement of physical metaverse infrastructure, a commercial Letter of Credit may be opened by the IMC under SWIFT MT700, ICC UCP600, with 60–90 day usance, supported by invoices and transport documents; ticket-settlement flows are not normally LC-backed and require direct MT103 or card-network settlement with timely conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP onshore deliverable forwards executed with an authorized IMC, settled at maturity against the official TRM, with tenors of one to twelve months covering ticket-revenue conversion lags
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards documented onshore with an authorized IMC (residents are not permitted to execute offshore NDFs on the peso)
Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP) with the treasury IMC for balance-sheet hedging of periodic USDC-to-fiat conversion exposure
Plain-vanilla foreign-exchange options (USD call / COP put) written by the IMC within an approved hedge framework for the virtual-event ticket cycle
USD-denominated foreign-currency deposit accounts at the IMC for short-term treasury duration management before mandatory conversion of export proceeds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the SAS domicile (e.g., Bogotá Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 following each December 31 fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous renewal accrues a 10% monthly surcharge on the renewal fee, capped at 100%, plus commercial registry fines; two consecutive years without renewal permits ex officio cancellation of the matrícula mercantil, extinguishing commercial legal capacity and triggering dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros de Propósito General (annual financial statements signed by the legal representative and certified accountant)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (filed with the annual renewal; a certified copy is retained for shareholder approval records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of the following year, within three months after the December 31 closing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission blocks the commercial registration renewal and triggers the same late-filing penalties; non-conforming statements expose the preparer and legal representative to DIAN inexactitud penalties under E.T. Art. 647.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de Asamblea Ordinaria (annual shareholders' meeting minutes approving financial statements, profit appropriation, and discharge of the legal representative)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas) registered with the Cámara de Comercio; director and legal-representative appointments recorded in the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting must be held by March 31; minutes recorded in the registered minute book within 30 days after the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unrecorded minutes render corporate resolutions ineffective against third parties and expose directors to fiduciary liability; late registration of appointment changes at the Chamber triggers minor administrative fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between August and October of the following year for December 31 fiscal-year filers, per the DIAN calendar keyed to the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of 5% of the tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100% (E.T. Art. 641), plus monthly default interest of approximately 27%–33% per annum; persistent non-filing authorizes DIAN assessment by estimation and suspension of the RUT status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena (annual tax-relevant third-party, shareholder, payment-rail, and token-issuance transaction report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (electronic submission via web services or the medios magnéticos platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually per the DIAN exógena calendar for the prior tax year, typically due between July and September
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely, incomplete, or inaccurate information is penalized under E.T. Art. 651, with fines up to 5% of the unreported transaction amounts, subject to UVT-based statutory caps.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Industria y Comercio (ICA) — annual municipal gross-receipts (franchise-type) declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury of the SAS domicile (e.g., Bogotá Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Municipal calendar; annual filers generally declare in April–May following the fiscal year-end, or bimonthly when gross receipts exceed the municipal threshold
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal late-filing surcharge of up to 5% per month, capped at 100%, plus default interest; unpaid ICA blocks issuance of the municipal paz y salvo required for Chamber renewals and public contracts.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
